tagline: Premium collection: a seal pup and a penguin as pets, two sets of wings, a pompom beanie, an igloo backpack with a resident seal, an aurora ring and an HD snowfall cape. Everything 3D, HD textures (4×), animated with the states the 0.2.1 engine already has (idle / walk / fly / sneak) – no client change needed.

vibey:polar_seal.story: idle 20 s: breathe → blink → head tilt → sit up and clap three times (hearts + soft squeak) → look around → roll over (snow puff) → shake → nap (eyes shut, deep breaths, 3D Zs rise and spin) → wake, stretch, blink-blink. walk 1.6 s: galumph, galumph, happy belly slide. fly: superman with flapping flippers. sneak: shy, blushing loaf.

vibey:polar_penguin.story: idle 16 s: look around → happy flipper flap with hops → a fish appears in the beak, tilt, toss, gulp (heart) → preen → little side-to-side dance. walk 2.4 s: four waddle steps with wiggling flippers, then a dive and belly slide. fly: frantic flapping, feet paddling. sneak: ducks into the scarf.

vibey:polar_igloo_backpack.story: idle 8 s: the seal pup pops out of the door (snow puff), looks left and right, blinks, waves a flipper, ducks back in; the pennant flutters. walk: the pack bounces, the pennant flaps.

vibey:polar_pompom_beanie.story: idle 3 s: a damped boing with squash and stretch, snowflakes off the pompom. walk: bounces with the steps, braids swing. fly: pompom, flaps and braids stream back.

vibey:polar_aurora_ring.story: idle 12 s: the ring turns once, a wave runs around it three times (panels bob and lean), the light drifts along the curtains (8-frame strip), three crystal snowflakes orbit the other way, sparkle sprites rise.

vibey:polar_aurora_wings.story: Two veils per side, each a chain of three emissive translucent segments. idle: slow ripple + occasional sparkles. fly: bigger flap with a travelling ripple and a stream of sparkle sprites. sneak: veils swept back.

vibey:polar_owl_wings.story: Arm → forearm → hand bones, lesser + greater coverts and alula as scalloped layers, 5 secondaries and 5 primaries as separate feather bones. idle: folded angel-style with a slow breath. walk: gentle bob. fly: one big clean flap, then a long glide with spread finger feathers (feathers drift off on the downstroke). sneak: tucked in tight.

vibey:polar_snowfall_cape.story: HD 4× cape texture, 8 frames: aurora ripples, stars twinkle, snow falls in a seamless loop, the penguin waves, the seal blinks. Purple fleece lining with teal snowflakes; the elytra get the night sky.

notes: Cosmetic animation states in 0.2.1 (AvatarDraw.COSMETIC_ANIMS): idle (always), walk (blended by walk speed, pets: by their own movement), fly (elytra or creative flying), sneak. There is no state for standing still for a while, falling, sprinting, swimming or riding.
The animation clock is global (Clock.now() % length), so long idle loops play the same moment for everyone: the seal naps for 5 s of every 20 s, not after the player has been idle.

Weights are blended additively; for pets walk = pet movement and fly = player flying are independent, so a pet that moves while the player flies plays walk + fly at full weight (sum 2). The pets' walk and fly were designed to look fine combined.
Walk weight saturates at normal walking speed (pets: almost immediately), so sprinting cannot be told apart: the belly slides are a phase of the walk loop instead.
Events of idle always run (also while walking); walk/fly/sneak events only above 50 % weight. Hearts, snow puffs and sparkles are therefore short and rare in idle.
Eyelids, the fish, the peeking pup and the nap Zs rest hidden inside the model and are moved out by idle offsets, so they disappear by themselves when walk/fly takes over (idle weight 0).

Proposed client states (not part of this task): idle_long (standing still > N s), fall (falling without elytra), sprint, swim, glide (elytra only, separate from creative fly), land (one-shot), hurt (one-shot) and a pet_sit state while the owner sits/rides; plus weight normalisation so walk + fly never sum above 1.
